name: Recital D
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the 2026 UN Climate Change Conference in Antalya, Türkiye (COP31)
part_text: whereas Article 37 of the Charter of Fundamental Rights of the European Union provides that environmental protection must be guaranteed in EU law; whereas Article 191 of the Treaty on the Functioning of the European Union provides that a high level of protection shall be established for the Union policy on the environment;
